# name: set-circle-slice-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Sets.circle_slice
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['1/2', '(by norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (c : ℝ) (hc : c ^ 2 < 1), circle ∩ {p | p.2 = c} = {(Real.sqrt (1 - c ^ 2), c), (-Real.sqrt (1 - c ^ 2), c)} := by
  intro c hc
  have hs : Real.sqrt (1 - c ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 - c ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
  ext ⟨x, y⟩
  simp only [circle, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
    Prod.mk.injEq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, rfl⟩
    have : (x - Real.sqrt (1 - y ^ 2)) * (x + Real.sqrt (1 - y ^ 2)) = 0 := by nlinarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 this with h | h
    · left; exact ⟨by linarith, rfl⟩
    · right; exact ⟨by linarith, rfl⟩
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · exact ⟨by linarith, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨by nlinarith, rfl⟩
exact @key (1/2) ((by norm_num))'),
    (['0', '(by norm_num)'], True, 'have key : ∀ (c : ℝ) (hc : c ^ 2 < 1), circle ∩ {p | p.2 = c} = {(Real.sqrt (1 - c ^ 2), c), (-Real.sqrt (1 - c ^ 2), c)} := by
  intro c hc
  have hs : Real.sqrt (1 - c ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 - c ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
  ext ⟨x, y⟩
  simp only [circle, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
    Prod.mk.injEq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, rfl⟩
    have : (x - Real.sqrt (1 - y ^ 2)) * (x + Real.sqrt (1 - y ^ 2)) = 0 := by nlinarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 this with h | h
    · left; exact ⟨by linarith, rfl⟩
    · right; exact ⟨by linarith, rfl⟩
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · exact ⟨by linarith, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨by nlinarith, rfl⟩
exact @key (0) ((by norm_num))'),
    (['3/5', '(by norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (c : ℝ) (hc : c ^ 2 < 1), circle ∩ {p | p.2 = c} = {(Real.sqrt (1 - c ^ 2), c), (-Real.sqrt (1 - c ^ 2), c)} := by
  intro c hc
  have hs : Real.sqrt (1 - c ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 - c ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
  ext ⟨x, y⟩
  simp only [circle, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
    Prod.mk.injEq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, rfl⟩
    have : (x - Real.sqrt (1 - y ^ 2)) * (x + Real.sqrt (1 - y ^ 2)) = 0 := by nlinarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 this with h | h
    · left; exact ⟨by linarith, rfl⟩
    · right; exact ⟨by linarith, rfl⟩
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · exact ⟨by linarith, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨by nlinarith, rfl⟩
exact @key (3/5) ((by norm_num))'),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, edge, proof in CASES]
